simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בֹּכִים (H1066) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בֹּכִים (Bôkîym) means Bo-kim , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Judg 2 1.

definitions.full: H1066. Bokim בֹּכִים proper name, of a location near Bethel , אלהַֿבֹּכִים Judg 2:1 , בֹּכִים 2:5 (compare 2:4 ); ᵐ5 2:1 τὸν Κλαυθμῶνα καὶ ἐπὶ Βαιθηλ ; 2:5 Κλαυθμῶνες i.e. יִם בְּכָּ ( ᵐ5 L Κλαυθμών ); — on possible connection with בָּכוּת אַלּוֺן Gen 35:8 compare Stu & We Bleek's Einl. ed. 4, 183, compare Hexateuch 1889, 215 ; but perhaps read ביתאל instead of בכים in 35:1 , compare We Bu RS20 .
definitions.rootNote: plural active participle of 1058 ; (with the article) the weepers;
